text.p: Following are some of the main
stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified
these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
** For summary of the FINANCIAL TIMES, click on [PRESS/FT]
** For summary of the WALL STREET JOURNAL, click on [PRESS/WSJ]
FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Finance Ministry's capital markets agency will convert all
Dutch government debt into euros as soon as European economic
and monetary union begins on January 1, 1999. (p1)
VOLKSKRANT
- Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm says Netherlands should aim
to reduce its budget deficit to zero under the new government
which takes office after elections in May 1998. (p1)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Unilever plans rapid expansion in Russia and is
in talks to acquire a margarine factory there. p25)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Chemicals group DSM plans campaign to reverse
declining interest of Dutch private investors in the company's
shares. (p 11).
- Philips still at loggerheads with Grundig
over its plans to cut back its ties with the
loss-making German consumer electronics group. (p11)
